content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: This is a web site hosting and support agreement under which TrueLink hosts our Web Site, Client Content, backups (Section 2(f)) and borrower/loan Credit Data, so the rule expects an exit clause. None exists. Section 14 only obliges TrueLink to keep providing Hosting and Support Services until the last day of the month following our termination notice — roughly 30-60 days of continued service, not transition or migration assistance. Section 13 (p0078) confirms we retain ownership of domains and Client Content and gives us 30/60 days to arrange a new name server and hosting environment, but it places that burden entirely on us and imposes no obligation on TrueLink to return, export or delete our data. Section 10 (Confidentiality) contains no return-or-destroy provision at all, so even that partial substitute is absent, and searches for return/export/delete/destroy/transition produced no relevant provision. The fallback (90 days' assistance plus data export within 30 days) therefore also fails. Inserted the preferred position into Section 14: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Client Content and Credit Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, then deletion with written certification. Placement in Section 14 is effective post-termination because Section 24 (p0090) provides that Sections 1 and 5 through 30 survive expiration or termination. We would accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return in machine-readable format, and certified deletion into Section 14 (Termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause requiring TrueLink, on expiry or termination, to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our Content and Credit Data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and then delete and certify deletion. As TrueLink hosts our Web Site and borrower data, the Agreement currently gives us no right to get that data back or to migrate in an orderly way; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates, including reasonable assistance in migrating the Web Site, Client Content and Client's data to Client or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content, Credit Data and other data and materials of Client then in TrueLink's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content, Credit Data and other data and materials from its systems and backup media and certify such deletion to Client in writing.
